goldens.comment: Mixing float: left with flexbox causes layout issues. Further this PR removes the float-based right alignment for .d-header .panel, which may cause the login panel in the non-Ember/noscript header (where .panel is nested inside .row and not a flex item) to stack under the title instead of remaining right-aligned.
goldens.reasoning: G1's main concern is that mixing float with flexbox breaks layout. C1 makes the same point: floats, including float: left on .topic-avatar and float: right on the button, stop working once .small-action becomes a flex container. The location may differ from the header .panel case, but the underlying issue is the same.

goldens.comment: -ms-align-items never existed in any version of IE/Edge; the correct legacy property is -ms-flex-align.
goldens.reasoning: No candidate mentions the invalid -ms-align-items prefix.

goldens.comment: -webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group require values starting from 1, not 0. If $val is 0, this will cause incorrect rendering in older browsers, leading to layout issues.
goldens.reasoning: No candidate mentions the box-ordinal-group values needing to start at 1.

candidates: app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:264 - Making `.small-action` a flex container stops the button's `float: right` from working.. After this change, `.small-action` is a flex container. Floats have no effect on flex items, so the `float: right` on `.small-action button` and the `float: left` on `.topic-avatar` are ignored. `.small-action-desc` has no `flex-grow`, so it is only as wide as its text. As a result, the action button (for example, the delete or edit control on a small-action post) sits right after the description text instead of at the right edge of the row. To fix it, give the button `margin-left: auto`, or give `.small-action-desc` `flex: 1`, so the button stays on the right.
